name: silvershop-suite/seo
description: Centralised SEO for SilverShop (CMS 6): per-page meta (canonical, robots, OpenGraph, Twitter), one coherent JSON-LD @graph assembled from pluggable structured-data providers, plus an XML sitemap and robots.txt.

suggest.silvershop-suite/reviews: Adds aggregate rating + reviews to the Product node and the shop rating to the Organization node.
suggest.silvershop-suite/brands: Adds the product brand to the Product node.
suggest.silvershop-suite/product-gallery: Uses the full product/variation gallery as the Product image[] and social-image source.
suggest.silvershop-suite/store-profile: Supplies the Organization / PostalAddress / ContactPoint data and the logo social-image fallback.
suggest.silvershop/stock: Sets the Offer availability (InStock / OutOfStock) from live stock levels.
suggest.silvershop-suite/search: Adds a WebSite SearchAction (sitelinks search box) pointing at the search page.
suggest.silverstripe/blog: Activates the Article / BlogPosting structured-data provider for blog posts.
suggest.tractorcow/silverstripe-fluent: Emits hreflang alternates and locale-correct canonicals when multilingual.
suggest.symbiote/silverstripe-queuedjobs: Schedules a background full-sitemap rebuild on large catalogs.
